name: WATCH! Fuuin no Yousei
source:
The protagonist, having been expelled from his familiar apartment, begins living in a dilapidated building when an earthquake causes a crystal ball to fall from the ceiling. Reflected within are images of women in lewd poses and numerous secrets unknown to anyone. Soon, the protagonist, filled with terror, sees a truth in the crystal ball that he should never have known.

[Translated from DMM]
